description: Every hand-curated Thisispaper guide and edition. Guides are places: Tokyo, Kyoto, Lisbon, Copenhagen. Editions are themes: Black Matter (black as a way of handling light), Jutaku (Japanese houses on narrow plots), Icons, Off-the-Grid, Monographs on single architects. Returns each one's title, type, one-line description, cover image and public URL. Filter by city or by type. The full guides and editions are reserved for Thisispaper+ members.

city.description: Optional city or region filter, e.g. 'tokyo' or 'portugal'. Applies to guides.

type.description: Optional: 'guide' for places, 'edition' for themes. Omit for both.
